movie.title: The Birthday Party
movie.overview: The late 1970s, somewhere in the Mediterranean: Marcos Timoleon, a tycoon, is throwing a lavish, extravagant birthday party for Sofia on his exclusive private island. The party is a perfect excuse for various people in his life to approach him with their own agendas.

reviews.author: Chris Sawin
reviews.content:
Old man butt cheeks and a pretty view are all *The Birthday Party* has to offer as a film. Willem Dafoe does what he can, but is surprisingly forgettable here. Sofia’s party ends up being extravagant and fruitless, which is also the perfect definition of the film.

https://bit.ly/DafoeParty

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: On a private Mediterranean island in the late 1970s, wealthy tycoon Marcos Timoleon hosts a lavish birthday celebration for Sofia, drawing guests with hidden agendas and personal ambitions.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In the late 1970s, shipping tycoon Marcos Timoleon hosts an extravagant birthday party for Sofia on his secluded Mediterranean island. Beneath the glamour and excess, the gathering serves as a battleground for political power, financial gain, and personal vendettas. As key figures from Timoleon's past and present navigate the festivities, hidden motives threaten to unravel the host's absolute control. Ultimately, the glamorous event exposes the calculated maneuvers and deep tension simmering within his inner circle.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Set against the backdrop of the late 1970s, powerful tycoon Marcos Timoleon gathers an elite crowd on his private Mediterranean island to celebrate Sofia's birthday. The opulent event is designed to project immense wealth and influence, but behind the scenes, it acts as a magnet for opportunistic guests. Politicians, business rivals, and family members use the occasion to corner Timoleon, each seeking to advance their own secretive agendas. Tensions escalate as competing interests collide over lavish dinners, late-night conversations, and private negotiations away from the crowd. Timoleon, accustomed to commanding total authority, must navigate a complex web of deceit and ambition to protect his empire. Personal loyalties are tested as secrets emerge, revealing the cost of his rise to power. The party shifts from a celebration into a high-stakes arena where power plays dictate every interaction. As the festivities draw to a close, the aftermath leaves permanent shifts in the dynamics between Timoleon and those vying for his favor.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set in the late 1970s on an exclusive Mediterranean island, The Birthday Party centers on Marcos Timoleon, a formidable tycoon who orchestrates a grand, luxurious celebration for Sofia. While the event appears to be an uninhibited display of wealth, culture, and high society, it functions as a convergence point for individuals across Timoleon's personal and professional life. Enticed by his vast influence, attendees arrive with distinct motives, ranging from securing financial backing and political alliances to settling old grievances. Through dense atmospheric drama and sharp character interactions, the narrative delves into themes of power, ambition, and the isolation that accompanies elite status, offering an engaging look at the strategic maneuvering hidden beneath a glamorous surface.
